title: TIME JUMP: Holding at G4, 16:00 CDT

fields.narration: THIS IS AN EXERCISE. The exercise clock is now 04:00, two hours after STARTEX. In the scenario it is 16:00 CDT on Tuesday, 16 March 2027. Kp 8, G4 Severe, has held since 15:10. The SWPC WARK08 warning is valid until 0300 UTC, which is 22:00 CDT tonight. NLTO is in Condition 4. Both transfer cuts are in place after agreement on the UMRC bridge. Arrowhead is now flowing 620 megawatts and North Shore 375 megawatts. Operating reserve is up by 200 megawatts. The Cloquet SVC and the Iron Range and Hartley capacitor banks are on line. All six planned 345 kV outages are deferred, and the Hartley AT-1 crew is standing by in the Hartley yard. Neutral currents: Iron Range AT2 146 amperes, Hartley AT1 118, Cloquet AT1 71, and the saw-tooth is getting steeper. Load is 2,880 megawatts and climbing toward the evening peak. The Condition 4 binder now shows 14 of 14. Baraga Wind Farm was reached by satellite phone at 15:58 and Duluth Harbor Terminal on the hotline at 15:59. The UMRC is at Emergency, with calls every 30 minutes, and the next call is at 16:30. The storm is still building. From here the room has to defend the system it has, not the one in the forecast.
worldState: Clock: 16:00 CDT / 2100 UTC, Tuesday 16 March 2027.
Space weather: Kp 8 (G4 – Severe) observed since 15:10 CDT (ALTK08, serial 0094). WARK08 (serial 0158) valid until 2027 Mar 17 0300 UTC (22:00 CDT). No sign of the storm easing.
NLTO status: Condition 4 (Severe storm). Termination criteria are not met.
Interfaces: Arrowhead 620 MW (limit 1,000 MW) and North Shore 375 MW (limit 600 MW). Both 10 percent reductions were agreed with the RC on the UMRC bridge.
Operating reserve raised by 200 MW. Cloquet SVC, Iron Range capacitor bank and Hartley capacitor bank are in service.
Outages: all six planned 345 kV outages are deferred. The Hartley AT-1 replacement crew and crane are standing by on site. Lakeshore's LPC-0309-345-07 tie outage is still out as planned until 18:00.
Neutral currents (EMS): IRON_RANGE_AT2_GIC_NEUT 146 A, HARTLEY_AT1_GIC_NEUT 118 A, CLOQUET_AT1_GIC_NEUT 71 A, all rising in a steeper saw-tooth. No transformer gas alarm so far.
Load: 2,880 MW, rising toward the evening peak.

Condition 4 entity notifications: 14 of 14 confirmed. Baraga Wind Farm by satellite phone at 15:58 and Duluth Harbor Terminal by hotline at 15:59, both inside 60 minutes of the 15:10 condition change.
UMRC: Emergency level, 30-minute bridge calls. Next call 16:30 CDT (2130 UTC).
Timing: the NORTH_SHORE GPS clock is still LOCKED with reduced satellites tracked and reduced C/N0.
fields.facilitatorNote: Read the narration aloud, then display the world-state list. This card is a consolidation point. Ask each role to state the current condition, flows and open items for the log. Check that the CRSS confirms the Condition 4 notification clock closed by 16:10 and names a binder keeper for the next condition change. Check that the RCSM confirms the 16:30 bridge and what NLTO will report on it.

instructorNote: This is a consolidation card before the Iron Range T2 decision. Watch whether the shift writes down the current condition, flows and open items, confirms that the Condition 4 notifications closed inside 60 minutes, assigns a binder keeper and confirms the 16:30 UMRC bridge. Duluth Harbor's contact time is given as 15:59 so it falls before the 16:00 card time; the MSEL row says 16:02.
